prompt: Write a list of years, beginning with 1924 and increasing in increments of 10 to the year 2014, and for each year, write a list of 3 notable works that were originally published in that year (the works can be books, movies, TV shows, music, video games, or any other type of work). After the 3 works, write something that explains how old the works will be in 2024 (e.g. a work published in 1974 will be 50 years old in 2024, and a work from 2004 will be 20)
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 best satisfies the prompt by listing all required years (1924–2014 in steps of 10), with ages for 2024 computed correctly, and with most of the cited works actually originating in the specified year. Candidate 2 contains multiple substantial year-mismatches across many years (e.g., several works originally released/published outside the requested year). Candidate 3 is also highly inaccurate, with many picks clearly originating in different years (often by large margins), reducing overall compliance. Candidate 4 performs the worst, with nearly all entries showing publication/release years that do not match the year being asked for.
